required_order:
struct OriginalArtifactHeadConnectionV1 {
    channel: HostAuthorityPeerChannel,
    config: ArtifactHeadSigningConfigV1,
    binding: Digest32,
    initial_at: u64,
    origin: Origin,
}

sequence:
from_original_stream(
        stream: UnixStream,
        peer: LearningIterationEvidencePeerV1,
        original_head_pidfd: OwnedFd,
        config: ArtifactHeadSigningConfigV1,
        timeout: Duration,
        lifetime: Duration,
    ) -> Result<Self, Error> {
        Self::bind(
            stream,
            peer,
            original_head_pidfd,
            config,
            timeout,
            lifetime,
            Origin::Fresh,
        )
    }

recover_original_stream(
        stream: UnixStream,
        peer: LearningIterationEvidencePeerV1,
        original_head_pidfd: OwnedFd,
        config: ArtifactHeadSigningConfigV1,
        expected: Option<SignedCurrentArtifactHeadV1>,
        timeout: Duration,
        lifetime: Duration,
    ) -> Result<Self, Error> {
        Self::bind(
            stream,
            peer,
            original_head_pidfd,
            config,
            timeout,
            lifetime,
            Origin::Readonly(expected),
        )
    }

required_order:
struct OriginalArtifactHeadOwnerV1<W: AnchorWitnessStore> {
    pub(super) source: Arc<OriginalArtifactRegistrySourceClientV1>,
    journal: Mutex<LearningOwnerJournalV1<W>>,
    original_key: Mutex<Option<SigningKey>>,
    key: ProductEvaluationExecutionKeyV1,
    original_subject: Digest32,
    admitted: AtomicBool,
    pub(super) connections: Arc<Semaphore>,
}

enum Status {
    Completed = 1,
    Missing = 2,
    Pending = 3,
    Unavailable = 4,
    ReadbackRequired = 5,
}

struct ArtifactHeadSigningConfigV1 {
    pub publication: OriginalArtifactPublicationContextV1,
    pub trust: ArtifactOwnerTrustV1,
    pub writer_lease: SignedArtifactWriterLeaseV1,
    pub storage_binding: Digest32,
    pub signer_id: StableId,
    pub authority_epoch: u64,
    pub signature_expires_at: u64,
}

struct OriginalArtifactRegistryDurableV1 {
    checkpoint: ArtifactOwnerPublicationCheckpointV1,
    registry: ArtifactRegistrySnapshot,
    registry_receipt: RegistrySnapshotReceipt,
    current: Option<SignedCurrentArtifactHeadV1>,
    writer_lease: SignedArtifactWriterLeaseV1,
    trust_digest: Digest32,
    observed_unix_millis: u64,
}

sequence:
same_original_read(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.checkpoint == other.checkpoint
            && self.registry == other.registry
            && self.current == other.current
            && self.writer_lease == other.writer_lease
            && self.trust_digest == other.trust_digest
    }
